svg.title: Ouro schematic
svg.text: Ouro electronics schematic (robot side). Net labels with the same name are connected.
All grounds common (star at the power board). Values: R1 100k 1%, R2 33k 1%, C3 100 nF, C2 220 uF 10 V low-ESR, R5 0.1 ohm 1 W.
All + pins joined, all - pins joined. Column k carries SIGk.
Closed (latched) = GPIO27 low. Internal ~45k pull-up; firmware debounces 15 ms.
Fallback: A3144 hall switch (open-collector) on the same net, no firmware change.
U2 VIN+ from U1 OUT+, VIN- to the servos: reads positive current.
R5 halves the shunt: 0.05 ohm, +-6.4 A range, 0.2 mA/LSB (firmware).
C2 kept at 220 uF: Mini560 trips at start-up into >~440 uF.
U3 feeds only the ESP32: a servo stall cannot reset the radio.
No reverse-polarity part: XT30 is keyed. Check polarity once
with a meter when you solder the pigtail (bring-up step 1).
